title: Behind the Door
subtitle: A path cleared ahead of you.

items.text: Behind the Door
Countdown to the "Storm"
Square, SPDM

items.speaker: Manus Believer
items.text: ㄢ!
Merel's soaring figure lunges forward. There's a flash of an arcane skill, then a nimble Moon-Eyed Fiddler dodges an incoming strike.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Kaarrr!
The rolling fiddler crab crashes into the watchtower's door, pushing it open.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Kaarr, hiss ...
A rotunda, somehow both stifling and spacious, welcomes her.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Hiss?
She has no time to ponder the question further. The moment she dispels her transformation, Merel rises to her feet and goes to close the door.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Ah!
But before she can shut it, something powerful shoves it back open, knocking her to the ground.
A heavy hammer swings toward her.

items.speaker: Manus Believer
items.text: ㄠ!

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: No way out.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: If you're outnumbered? You run. Simple as that.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: No heroics. Dead soldiers don't win wars.

items.speaker: Yermolai
items.text: Invisibility incantations might help, but arcanum isn't reliable. Guns never fail. Burn that into your skull.
Merel rolls out of the path of the hammer just as it slams down.
Arcane radiance conceals her body. All that's left is her voice echoing in the rotunda.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Let's see how you like this.
*bang*
She empties her magazine.

items.speaker: Manus Believer
items.text: ㄞ!
Gunshots. Screams. A brief pause on both sides. Then she reloads.

items.speaker: Manus Believer
items.text: ㄤ?
The cluster of believers falls back. Black ooze and blood splatter reveal Merel's silhouette even before her optical illusion fades.
She charges toward the stairs and turns to face her enemies. They're retreating upstairs.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Second floor. There's a door. I can lock them out. Should buy a little time.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: I just hope the security team's master key works here.
*bang-bang*
Merel fires two shots straight ahead in an attempt to buy herself a few seconds of respite, then turns and runs toward the second floor's blast door.
The key sticks in the lock with a frustrating clink.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Come on. Don't do this to me.

items.speaker: Manus Believer
items.text: ㄠ!
She reflexively shields her face with her hand only to find that her foe's arcane skill hasn't hit her. A square of metal mesh, curved by the impact, rocks back and forth on the ground.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Wh-Where did that come from?

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: Heads up!
A young girl pokes her head out from the vent. Radiance still lingers from the staff in her hand.

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: Seems like I did the incantation right.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Emilia? What on earth are you doing here?

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: Shouldn't I be asking you that?
Though she answers the question with one of her own, she exits the vent rather than waiting for a response.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: No, wait. Just stay right there.

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: There are so many of them. Why are they gathering around like this?
Regret wells up in Merel's throat.
The blast door feels like the jaws of a trap. They're cornered now.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Hop on, Emilia! I'll get you back into the air vent.

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: What about you? You won't fit in there.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: I'll find a way.
*click*
The sound of salvation comes from the door behind them.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Wait. It's open?
She doesn't have time to consider the answer.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Emilia, help me open this door.

items.speaker: Lucas
items.text: Hey!
Lucas's youthful face flushes red with effort as he pulls on the door.

items.speaker: Lucas
items.text: Quick! Get in.
The three of them shut their pursuers out. Only when the lock clicks into place do they let out a sigh of relief.
Second Floor, Central Watchtower

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: *pant*
Merel straightens up and turns to the young children, her saviors, adopting an uncharacteristically serious expression.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Lucas, Emilia, what are you two doing out here?

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: They put us in detention, remember? Then the alarm went off, and an explosion blew a hole through the wall, so we ran.
Merel stumbles over her thoughts and looks away. She can hardly criticize them for running to safety.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Sorry. You wouldn't have been left in there if it weren't for me.

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: Oh. That wasn't your fault. We broke the rules, after all.

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: We knew the central tower was where people were supposed to go, so we headed here. Looks like that was a mistake.

items.speaker: Lucas
items.text: We ran into a whole load of weird monsters on the way here. Guess what the instructor said about the dangers outside wasn't just to scare us after all.

items.speaker: Lucas
items.text: But where is everyone, miss?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: The library. That's where the instructors sent everyone. I just came from there.
Lucas leaps to his feet.

items.speaker: Lucas
items.text: See, Emilia? I told you we should've gone to the library.

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: There's always security here at the tower. How was I supposed to know they'd all be gone?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Alright, you two, now's not the time.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: I'll get you to the library. But first, there's something important I need to get from upstairs.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: You two get back in the vent and wait.
She looks down in thought, attempting to devise some plan to get these kids from here to safety, but her thoughts are quickly interrupted.

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: What do you mean? Can't we go with you?

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Well, it ... it's too dangerous.

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: All the more reason to not split up.

items.speaker: Lucas
items.text: She's right. And trust me. You're gonna need us. I know all kinds of stuff they don't teach in class.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: No. Please, both of you listen. I've fought those monsters before. They don't care how smart you are or how many incantations you know.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: See that hammer that guy's holding? I've seen it smash trained soldiers to pieces.
The young, caged doves stare at her blankly for a long moment.

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: But how are you going to get up there? Every door is locked except the main one. We've checked.

items.speaker: Lucas
items.text: That's why we ended up hiding in the vent.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: I've got a master key.

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: But it didn't look like it worked on that door you tried it on.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Well, then I'll shapeshift and get to the top through the vent. Once I've got what I need, I'll open the door from the inside and take the stairs.

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: That won't work. The vent was blocked in the explosions. You can't get past the second floor. We've tried.

items.speaker: Lucas
items.text: And the blast doors won't open from the inside.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: What do you mean? Didn't you just open that one for me?

items.speaker: Lucas
items.text: No. I thought you opened it.

items.speaker: Emilia
items.text: I just told you. Her key doesn't work.

items.speaker: Merel
items.text: Then who did open it?
All sense of direction are lost.
Dust swirls in the air.
You've come to me at last, Vertin.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Who are you? Where's Sonetto?
There is no name that I might give you that will serve your understanding.
As for your friend—she was not meant to be here.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Your voice ... I've heard it before. Through the monitor.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But you're not Arcana.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You are the true creator of this "boon."
